text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The bitter memory of that past defeat—
not once had it left my mind.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... I honed myself through discipline.
For today, for this very moment...
choice_data_list: Let's show off the fruits of your hard work!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aye! Today I am brimming with confidence! I shall most certainly redeem my honor!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The one to conquer the realm
is none other than No Reason!
